show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: When a peaceful kingdom is shattered by an unexpected invasion, a brave young warrior rises to unite scattered tribes and fight for survival. As ancient prophecies awaken and enemies close in, the fate of the wild lands rests on his courage and destiny.
